description: This Java class 'UserDetailsServiceImpl' implements Spring Security's UserDetailsService to load user details from a UserRepository by email, returning a UserDetails object with user's email, password hash, and authorities.

classes.name: UserDetailsServiceImpl
classes.description: Custom implementation of UserDetailsService that loads user details for Spring Security.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads a user by email, throwing UsernameNotFoundException if user not found, and returns a UserDetails object with user's email, password, and authorities.
